tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Build CIF Library
tool.description: build a reusable mini or augmented candidate library
tool.command: touch '$library_archive' '$library_manifest' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$library_archive' '$library_manifest' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && mkdir -p cif_inputs library_output && #if str($cif_source.source_kind) == 'files' #for $index, $cif_file in enumerate($cif_source.cif_files) ln -s '$cif_file' 'cif_inputs/candidate_${index}.cif' && #end for #else #for $index, $cif_file in enumerate($cif_source.cif_collection) ln -s '$cif_file' 'cif_inputs/candidate_${index}.cif' && #end for #end if library_args=(python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py build-library --cif-dir cif_inputs --library-mode '$library_mode' --radiation '$radiation') && #if str($library_mode) == 'augmented' library_args+=(--base-db-root "\${RADAR_PD_DB_ROOT}/database_${radiation}") && #end if library_args+=(--output-root library_output --manifest-output '$library_manifest' --archive '$library_archive') && #if str($overwrite) not in ('', 'None', 'False') library_args+=($overwrite) && #end if "\${library_args[@]}" > >(tee -a '$console_output') 2> >(tee -a '$console_output' >&2)

param.name: source_kind
param.label: How would you like to provide the CIFs?
param.help: For files on your computer, first use Galaxy Upload in the left activity bar. The uploaded CIFs then appear in the individual-file selector below.
param.option: Use an existing Galaxy CIF collection

param.name: cif_files
param.label: Candidate CIF files
param.help: Select all CIF datasets to include. Use Ctrl/Command or the dataset selector checkboxes to select more than one.

param.name: cif_collection
param.label: Galaxy CIF collection
param.help: Choose a reusable list collection whose elements are CIF datasets.

tool.help: Builds a portable RADAR-PD library from one or more CIF files. To add CIFs from your laptop, open **Upload** in Galaxy's left activity bar, upload the `.cif` files, then return here and select them under **Candidate CIF files**. A prebuilt Galaxy list collection is also supported for repeatable workflows. "Only my CIFs" creates a compact standalone library. "Built-in + my CIFs" augments the matching read-only MP/COD catalog. The resulting ZIP is preserved in Galaxy history and can be selected as the candidate library in RADAR-PD Analyze.
